*   **Full Legal Name:** [Your Full Name]

> **Country of Issuance:** India
> **Full Name:** [Your Name as it appears on the passport]
> **Date of Birth:** [Your DOB]
> 
> Could you please advise me on the necessary forms, identity verification steps, and any associated fees required to process this request?

> Thank you for your time and assistance.

> **Full Name:** [Your Name as it appears on the ID]
> **Date of Birth:** [Your DOB]
